abilities.name: Natural Cure
abilities.description: cures any major status ailment upon switching out.

abilities.name: Analytic
abilities.description: strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If it has full HP, the holder will endure one potential KO attack, leaving 1 HP.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: A hold item that gradually restores HP in battle.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This scarf boosts Speed, but allows the use of only one kind of move.

items.name: Hard Stone
items.description: A hold item that raises the power of ROCK-type moves.

items.name: Mystic Water
items.description: A hold item that raises the power of WATER-type moves.

items.name: Bright Powder
items.description: A hold item that casts a glare to reduce accuracy.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: A hold item that restores 30 HP in battle.

items.name: Colbur Berry
items.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe’s supereffective Dark-type attack.

items.name: Scope Lens
items.description: A hold item that raises the critical- hit rate.

items.name: Never-Melt Ice
items.description: A hold item that raises the power of ICE-type moves.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: A hold item that snaps POKéMON out of infatuation.

items.name: Wacan Berry
items.description: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe’s supereffective Electric-type attack.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: The user protects itself from incoming moves for the turn. With each consecutive use this move's chance of success becomes 1/3 of what it was before.

moves.name: Scald
moves.description: Has a 30% chance of burning the target. Cures the user and target of being frozen.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: Has a 10% chance of freezing the target.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: Has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage.

moves.name: Minimize
moves.description: Boosts the user's evasiveness by 2 stages. The user gains the Minimized status.

moves.name: Cosmic Power
moves.description: Boosts the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats by 1 stage.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: Restores 1/2 of the user's max HP.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.description: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.description: Gives the target the Bound status. This move's power is doubled if the target has the Submerged status.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: This is a special move but the damage it deals is calculated using the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Flip Turn
moves.description: After attacking the user switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: Lowers targets' Speed stats by 1 stage.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: This move's power is doubled against targets that have the Submerged status.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: Has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: Expanding Force
moves.description: If the user is under the effect of Psychic Terrain this move's power is boosted by 50% and its range extends to all opponents.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: Gives the entire field the Trick Room status for 5 turns.

moves.name: Rapid Spin
moves.description: Removes the Bound and Leech Seeded statuses from the user and removes the Sticky Web Stealth Rock Spikes and Toxic Spikes statuses from the user's side. Boosts the user's Speed stat by 1 stage.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description: The user and the target swap their Abilities.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: The user and the target swap their held items.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: Has a 10% chance of freezing targets. This move never misses in snow.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: Summons rain for 5 turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: Gives the user's side the Reflect status for 5 turns.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: Has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.

moves.name: Ally Switch
moves.description: The user switches spots with one of its allies. With each consecutive use this move's chance of success becomes 1/3 of what it was before.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.description: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: Has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: Gives the user's side the Light Screen status for 5 turns.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target. This move never misses in rain and can hit a target that has the Sky-High status.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: Boosts the user's Speed stat by 2 stages.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: Has a 10% chance of boosting the user's Attack Defense Sp. Atk Sp. Def and Speed stats by 1 stage.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: Gives the target the Infatuated status. This move will fail against a target that is the same gender as the user or whose gender is unknown.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the target has already dealt damage to the user with a move in the same turn.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: Boosts the user's Attack and Defense stats by 1 stage.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: Has a 70% chance of boosting the user's Sp. Atk stat by 1 stage.

moves.name: Chilling Water
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack stat by 1 stage.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.description: Confuses the target.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: Ghost-type: The user loses 1/2 of its max HP to give the target the Cursed status. Non-Ghost-type: Lowers the user's Speed stat by 1 stage and boosts its Attack and Defense stats by 1 stage.

moves.name: Dive
moves.description: The user gains the Submerged status on the turn this move is used then attacks on the following turn.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: Boosts the user's evasiveness by 1 stage.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: During the turn this move is used if the user takes damage from a move that would knock it out it will endure the hit with 1 HP. With each consecutive use this move's chance of success becomes 1/3 of what it was before.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned badly poisoned burned or paralyzed. Although this move is a physical move the damage it deals is not halved when the user is burned.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user gains the Recharging status on the turn after this move is used.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The heavier the target the greater this move's power (ranging between 20 and 120).

moves.name: Gravity
moves.description: Gives the entire field the Gravity status for 5 turns.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.description: The lower the user's Speed stat compared to the target's the greater this move's power (ranging between 1 and 150).

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The user gains the Recharging status on the turn after this move is used.

moves.name: Ice Spinner
moves.description: Removes any terrain.

moves.name: Liquidation
moves.description: Has a 20% chance of lowering the target's Defense stat by 1 stage.

moves.name: Meteor Beam
moves.description: The user gains the Charging status on the turn this move is used then attacks on the following turn. The user's Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 1 stage on the turn this move is used.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.description: The user adds its remaining HP to the target's remaining HP then splits the total in half for them to share.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user copies the target's stat changes.

moves.name: Psycho Cut
moves.description: This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.

moves.name: Recycle
moves.description: Regenerates the last held item that the user consumed. The user then holds this item once more.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: Fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions. The user falls asleep for 2 turns. This move fails if the user's HP is full.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: If multiple Pokémon use this move in the same turn the second user onward will act immediately after the first and the power of the second Round onward will be doubled.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: Gives the user's side the Safeguard status for 5 turns.

moves.name: Self-Destruct
moves.description: The user faints upon using this move.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: Can be used only if the user is asleep. The user uses one of the other moves it knows at random.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: Can be used only if the user is asleep. Has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user loses 1/4 of its max HP to create a substitute. The substitute will be hit by moves instead of the user and it will vanish when it takes damage equal to 1/4 of the user's max HP.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: Boosts the target's Attack stat by 2 stages and confuses it.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: Paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: Badly poisons the target. If the user is a Poison type this move will never miss.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.description: Has a 20% chance of leaving the target burned frozen or paralyzed.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: Has a 20% chance of confusing the target.

moves.name: Wonder Room
moves.description: Gives the entire field the Wonder Room status for 5 turns.

moves.name: Zap Cannon
moves.description: Paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: Has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.
